svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="aGmh_qM76p6o4l87Jqmp"> <mxGraphModel dx="1303" dy="-6483" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="850" background="light-dark(#ffffff, #121212)" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "
@startuml
title BrewLite - Activity Diagram: End-to-End Ordering

skinparam shadowing false
skinparam activity {
 BackgroundColor White
 BorderColor #555555
 FontSize 13
 DiamondBackgroundColor #FFF2CC
 DiamondBorderColor #B8860B
}
skinparam ArrowColor #555555

|Customer|
start
:Open BrewLite;
:View product list;
:Select product;
:View product details;
:Add product to cart;
:Open cart;
:Review cart;

if (Cart empty?) then (Yes)
 :Display empty cart;
 stop
else (No)
 :Select Checkout;
endif

|System|
:Check authentication;

if (Logged in?) then (No)
 |Customer|
 :Enter login credentials;

 |System|
 :Validate credentials;

 if (Credentials valid?) then (No)
 :Display login error;
 stop
 else (Yes)
 :Create authenticated session;
 endif
else (Yes)
endif

:Validate cart;
:Check product availability;
:Check stock quantity;

if (Products available?) then (No)
 :Return out-of-stock information;

 |Customer|
 :Adjust quantity or remove product;
 stop
else (Yes)
endif

|System|
:Calculate order total;
:Display checkout summary;

|Customer|
:Confirm order information;
:Choose payment method;
:Submit payment request;

|System|
:Create payment request;
:Generate idempotency key;

|Payment Service|
:Process payment;
:Return payment result;

|System|
if (Payment successful?) then (Yes)
 :Update payment status to SUCCESS;
 :Confirm order;
 :Update inventory consistently;
 :Clear or mark cart as processed;
 :Create order confirmation;

 |Customer|
 :View order confirmation;
 stop

else (No)
 :Update payment status to FAILED;
 :Keep order unpaid;
 :Display payment failure message;

 |Customer|
 if (Retry payment?) then (Yes)
 :Request payment retry;

 |System|
 :Verify payment status and idempotency key;
 :Create or reuse valid retry request;

 |Payment Service|
 :Process retry payment;

 |System|
 :Return retry result;
 :Display updated payment result;
 stop

 else (No)
 :Cancel retry;
 stop
 endif
endif

@enduml
